Jwt.//SigningKey: Left empty on purpose — a signing key in source control is a signing key everybody has. Supply it as the Jwt__SigningKey environment variable (docker-compose.yml sets one for the demo stack). Outside Development an empty key fails startup; in Development, Program.cs generates a throwaway one per run.

//Logging: The Logging:LogLevel section is gone on purpose. Serilog is the logging provider now (see Logging/LoggingSetup.cs), and leaving both in place gives two sets of level rules that both apply — the quietest wins, and working out which one silenced a message is a bad afternoon. Levels live under Serilog:MinimumLevel below; sinks are set in code.
